page.title: Cat care map
page.subtitle: Find vet clinics and emergency care near you.
page.body: A list of vet clinics, emergency care, labs and stores compiled by CatCheck. Details may change, so call ahead before you go.

location.ready: Sorting places from nearest to farthest based on your current location (accuracy about ±{{accuracy}} m).
location.approximate: Only an approximate area could be determined (accuracy about ±{{accuracy}} m), so distances are for reference only.
location.denied: Location permission not granted, so all places are shown. Allow location in your browser to see distances.
location.unavailable: Couldn't get your location, so all places are shown. Check your GPS and try again.
location.manual: Allow your browser to share your location to see the distance to each place.
location.nearbyLoading: Looking for vet clinics near you on OpenStreetMap…
location.nearbyFound: Found {{count}} more vet clinics near you from OpenStreetMap.
location.nearbyNone: No additional vet clinics found within {{radius}} km on OpenStreetMap.
location.moreOnGoogle: Find more near you on Google Maps
location.nearbyError: Couldn't look up clinics near you on OpenStreetMap; showing the CatCheck list.

source.osmNote: From OpenStreetMap community data, not verified by CatCheck. Directions and calling only; booking through CatCheck isn't available yet.

search.placeholder: Enter a ward, district or place name…
search.label: Search by area or place name

map.attribution: Map uses OpenStreetMap data; pins come from coordinates in CatCheck's place list and from vet clinics near you recorded by the OpenStreetMap community.

list.title: Places in the list
list.loadError: Couldn't load the list of places.
list.dataNote: Names, addresses, phone numbers and specialties are compiled by CatCheck and have not been confirmed by the places themselves.

clinic.dataNotice: Place details are compiled by CatCheck and have not been confirmed by the place itself. Call to confirm before you go.
clinic.notFound: This place is no longer listed or the link is incorrect.
clinic.loadError: Check your connection and try again.

booking.notePlaceholder: Describe what you've noticed about your cat, or the service you need…
